keyFindings.description: The outbox relay sends a controller notice for a root that waits for its slot (architectEnded is true for a claim state of ""), for example carried-gate-opened on a handed-over root in todo. This contradicts AGENTS.md:404 and the ask relay's waitsForSlot rule. Fix: one shared relay helper that checks the person, keeps the decision, and leaves out the controller notice for a root that waits for its slot. Both relay paths call it. This also closes thread PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6v-NK4.

ParkedDecisionTask deletes the kept rows when the start or catch-up row is queued, not when it is delivered. A start that finishes without acting (the tree lingers again, a stale generation) or a catch-up that finishes undelivered loses the decision. For a root that waits for its slot, no controller notice was sent either, so the decision is lost. Fix: take the decisions when they are delivered, or keep them again on each finish-without-acting branch. This also closes thread PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6v-NK2.

No committed test fails when the `root.AwaitingPerson()` guard or the `admittedRoot` guard is removed from waitsForSlot (the tester's mutation; TestAnAnswerOnARunningTreeSendsNothing seeds in_progress, so it returns before admittedRoot runs). Add an awaiting_person root at todo and a slotted root at todo, each with a person's reply that keeps nothing and sends nothing.

The relay fires for any root that lingers, including one that releaseUnslotted leaves at in_progress, testing, needs_review or retro. Step 1 has branches only for backlog/icebox, done and triage, so the controller has no instruction for those statuses. Fix: add a branch for any other status (set nothing, name it), or limit the relay to those statuses.

relayParkedDecision has three modes and checks for a person with two different predicates, `actor.Person()` at its callers and record.PersonActor inside. It checks Lingers again inside waitsForSlot. dispatchAskReply should log a session's reply itself. Fold this into the shared helper.
closeAsk/replyToAsk return intake.Result{} on every path, and their callers discard it. Make them return only error.
SpecDecision casts NoticeKind to DecisionKind, which works only because the two sets of constants share their text. Use an explicit mapping.
`row any` is always int64: type it.
readmit reuses `gate`, which means the carried gate at :851, for the key's own gate. Use a helper with its own local variable.
The parked-decision section repeats the own-hold rule from parked-decisions.md#deciding and has drifted from it: it leaves out the 10-minute window. Cut it to the payload and a pointer.
